  echo "Error: .env.test file not found"
  exit 1
fi

echo "Validating required environment variables..."

# Source the .env.test file
set -a
source .env.test
set +a

required_vars=("DB_HOST" "DB_PORT" "DB_USER" "DB_PASSWORD" "API_KEY")

for var in "${required_vars[@]}"; do
  if [ -z "${!var}" ]; then
    echo "Error: $var is not set or empty in .env.test"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "✓ $var is set"
done

echo "All required environment variables are present."

# Extract config from .env.test and convert to JSON
config_json=$(cat .env.test | grep -v '^#' | grep -v '^$' | awk -F= '{gsub(/\r/, "", $2); printf "%s\"%s\": \"%s\"%s", (NR>1)?", ":"", $1, $2, "\n"}' | awk '{printf "%s%s", $0, (NR>1 && /,$/) ? "" : "\n"}' | sed '$ s/,$//' | awk 'BEGIN{printf "{\n"} {printf "  %s", $0} END{printf "\n}\n"}')

# Verify JSON is properly formatted
if ! echo "$config_json" | python3 -m json.tool > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Error: Failed to create valid JSON from .env.test"
  exit 1
fi

echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."

# Send the config to the deployment orchestrator
response=$(curl -s -w "\\n%{http_code}" -X POST http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$config_json")

# Extract HTTP status code
http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
response_body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

  echo "Error: Failed to send config to deployment orchestrator (HTTP $http_code)"

  exit 1

  echo "Error: Failed to create archive"
